deviations_from_card: layerFrame signature is layerFrame(draw, pose, rig: FaceRig, map: FaceMapping, out) - an out-param so there is no per-frame allocation; FaceRig carries the per-frame lift/upperLip/aperture and depth's look eye slide. Also exported describeLayer (build-time float/eye params, was copied 3x) and the three mappings GLOW_/CUT_/DEPTH_MAPPING with the divergence table in layer-frame.ts's header (gaze px, follow source, ring breath). Commit series is 4 not 6: goldens; layer-frame+gl-kit+glow; cut(+gpu.ts); depth+layer-frame.test.ts (the rule tests were committed with the last renderer because the source-guard cases are red until all three switch). Intermediate commits were not individually re-gated in a checkout of that sha; the final tree is. glow's program build now asks getExtension after link (as cut/depth did) and its two distinct build-error messages became gl-kit's one; status queries are outside the golden by design.
notes: Renderers shrank: glow 403->299, cut/renderer 396->334, depth/renderer 370->292 lines.
